Subject: Request: CAIQ controls mapping + evidence for procurement

Hi Marcus (and cc Olga),

Thanks for the demo last week — Zephyr's procurement team is advancing our security review and has asked for a CAIQ-style mapping to the Cloud Controls Matrix and the supporting evidence (SOC2 report, encryption screenshots, retention policy, etc.).

Do you have:
- A CAIQ/CCM mapping spreadsheet that indicates which controls Redwood covers?
- Attachable artifacts we can share with our security reviewers (SOC2 Type 2, architecture diagram, KMS/HSM proof)?

Our timeline is tight — procurement would like the package by Friday 4/16 so we can keep the deal on the May renewal. If there's a smaller set you prefer we share first, happy to take that.

Cheers,
Elena Marquez
Security Program Manager — Zephyr Cloud
elena.marquez@zephyrcloud.com

Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ controls mapping + evidence for procurement

Hi Elena — thanks, we can provide that. Attaching a first-pass CAIQ mapping and our latest SOC2 Type II. High-level notes below and a suggested delivery plan.

What I attached:
- CAIQ_Mapping_v1.xlsx: tabbed sheet mapping CSA CAIQ control IDs to Redwood controls, implementation notes, and where evidence is located (tab references).
- SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2025.pdf: full report (redacted vendor names per contract).

Summary (short):
- Coverage: ~85% of CAIQ control statements mapped to existing Redwood controls or compensating processes. Remaining items are typically procurement/3rd-party questions or architecture-level details (we flag those in the spreadsheet).
- Encryption & Key Mgmt (CCM-EKM tabs): we use customer-isolated KMS keys for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted API keys are encrypted in-transit and at-rest with AES-256; HSM-backed KMS available for enterprise customers (see evidence bundle contents).
- Data retention & deletion (CCM-DR tabs): documented retention policy + deletion playbooks included; for Private deployments customers control retention via config.

Delivery plan:
1) I will upload a curated evidence bundle with screenshots, architecture diagram, policy PDFs, and a short control-trace document (evidence_bundle_v1.zip) by EOD tomorrow.
2) If you need specific redacted logs (e.g., audit trail for a control), please call that out and we'll provide a sample export under NDA.
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute review to walk through the mapping.

Please review the spreadsheet and call out any controls you want us to expand on.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Information Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — Security Team

Attachment: CAIQ_Mapping_v1.xlsx; SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2025.pdf
From: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@zephyrcloud.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ controls mapping + evidence for procurement

Thanks, Olga — spreadsheet looks comprehensive. A couple quick clarifications from our security reviewers after scanning the mapping:

1) CCM-DR (Data Retention / Deletion): we need either a documented sample of retention policy AND an example deletion runbook showing the steps and an auditor-facing log/output. Does Redwood have a standard deletion runbook you can share or a sample log export?

2) CCM-EKM (Encryption & Key Management): the mapping mentions HSM-backed KMS for enterprise customers. We need a short artifact confirming HSM usage (attestation screenshot or a redacted KMS config showing key origin = HSM). Is that available for Dedicated/Private customers?

3) For one of our compliance reviewers, a single ZIP with named evidence files is preferable. Can you include a manifest inside the ZIP that ties each evidence file to the CAIQ control IDs?

If you can send the evidence bundle and manifest by Friday EOD, procurement can proceed. Also, please include the HubSpot deal link in the artifacts so our procurement team can reconcile.

Cheers,
Elena

Elena — attaching the evidence bundle you requested and a manifest that maps each artifact to CAIQ control IDs. Highlights and answers to your clarifying questions below.

Attachments included (evidence_bundle_v2.zip):
- manifest.csv (mapping: file name -> CAIQ control IDs -> short description)
- architecture_diagram.pdf (shows network segmentation, regions, and routing)
- kms_hsm_attestation.png (redacted screenshot showing key origin = HSM for Dedicated customer example)
- retention_policy.pdf (official policy)
- deletion_runbook_sample.pdf (procedural steps + sample audit output log)
- SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2025.pdf (same as before)

Answers: 
- Deletion runbook: deletion_runbook_sample.pdf contains the scripted steps we execute and a sample audit log extract labeled with timestamps and request IDs. That should meet your auditor's ask. If they need a live export, we can provide a timebound sample under an NDA and with redactions.
- HSM proof: kms_hsm_attestation.png is a redacted management console screenshot that indicates key origin. For customers requiring deeper proof we offer HSM-backed KMS provisioning on Dedicated/Private; we can provide a letter of attestation as part of the contract addendum.
- Bundle manifest: manifest.csv ties each file to CAIQ control IDs and the tab in CAIQ_Mapping_v1.xlsx where the control mapping is discussed.

Next steps:
- I can hop on a 30-minute walkthrough with you and your security reviewer to run through any controls where the mapping or evidence isn't sufficient. Suggested times: 4/16 10:00-10:30am PT or 4/16 3:00-3:30pm PT — which works?
- HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ZephyrCloud is included in the manifest and the bundle metadata.

Let me know if you'd like additional redactions or an NDA before we share any live audit extracts.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Information Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
